Hi there! I’m Sijan (yep, I go by my last name—ask me about the story someday!). I’m a Ph.D. student in Industrial-Organizational Psychology, with a concentration in Data Science. Welcome to my little corner of the internet—a place where I talk unfiltered about the things that fascinate me, the things I think everyone should know, and the ideas I am trying to nurture. I am also endlessly curious about how we can build better, fairer tools to measure human behavior—sometimes using NLP, AI, and, of course, good old psychometrics. Oh, and I teach undergraduate statistics too. Poke around, explore, and maybe learn something new—or at least get a peek into how my mind works!
